status_at_freeze: No new-cohort models fitted, correlations inspected, or predictive outcomes scored. Completed integrity/feasibility validation reused.
question: Do training-activity-defined groups improve concurrent running-speed decoding beyond same-size randomized groups and unrestricted activity+ID attention?
scope: Prospectively specified replication on four new mice of a previously exploratory method; separate within-session fits, not cross-animal model transfer. Local freeze, not external preregistration.

preprocessing.binning: Keep first3*floor(T/3) samples; mean contiguous triples independently for every neuron and speed. Activity means float32, speed float64. No interpolation, extra smoothing or clipping of tiny negative activity.
preprocessing.splits: Half-open binned indices: a=floor(3*T/5), b=floor(4*T/5); train[0,a-50), selection[a+50,b-50), evaluation[b+50,T). Exclude100 bins at each internal split boundary.
preprocessing.eligibility: Training binned activity population std>1e-6, ddof=0 with float64 accumulation. No speed association or held-out values used.
preprocessing.pool: np.random.default_rng(101).choice(ascending eligible original row indices,2048,replace=False), reset for each mouse. Preserve sampled order and original row IDs across all arms.
preprocessing.normalization: Per-cell mean/std on full training interval; speed mean/std on binned speed[7:train_end]. ddof=0, float64 accumulation, std floor1e-6. Apply same statistics to all splits/arms, then cast model tensors to float32.
preprocessing.windows: 8 bins; targets t=start+31 through stop-1; input bins[t-7,t+1). Keep inherited target offset31. No window crosses a split. Nominal9.6 seconds per input; concurrent decoding, not forecasting.
preprocessing.preflight_failure: Stop/report fewer than2048 eligible cells, invalid split sizes, nonfinite required values or speed[7:train_end] std<=1e-6; do not substitute mice based on outcomes.

groups.functional: standardize each training time course to unit L2 norm; eigendecompose cell correlation matrix; top32 scaled eigenvectors; KMeans8 n_init10 seed500000+pool; training activity only, no speed or coordinates
groups.details: Use hashed reference functional_groups(training_activity,pool=101): float64 Torch correlation/eigendecomposition, top32 scaled eigenvectors, KMeans8 n_init10 max_iter300 seed500101. Check nearest-center labels independently and require >=2 cells/group.
groups.random: Permute functional label vector with np.random.default_rng(420101).permutation(2048), separately for each mouse. Preserve exact group sizes; same assignment for both seeds.
groups.freeze: Save original IDs and groups from training activity before fits; no outcome-based reclustering.

architecture: same 81377 parameters,16 summaries,width32,4heads,nonlinear activity embedding,ID vectors,mean readout; first8 summaries masked by groups,last8 unrestricted; global arm all16 unrestricted
coordinates: all-zero coordinate inputs in every model; true xyz used only for final visualization

training.checkpoint: minimum selection bounded MSE including epoch0
training.paired_randomness: Same initial parameters and batch order per mouse/seed across arms; torch.manual_seed(seed), DataLoader generator seed=seed.
training.early_stopping: Strict selection improvement resets stale; stop at epoch>=12 and stale>=7, otherwise epoch24. Ties keep earlier checkpoint.
training.reference: Hashed reference run.py fit() and GroupCandidate; adapt data loading, split metadata and per-mouse orchestration.

evaluation.lock: Freeze all24 checkpoint hashes before scoring any later split. Never pass evaluation examples to training/checkpoint selection.
evaluation.primary_metric: MSE after clamping normalized prediction below at -speed_mean/speed_std (zero physical speed).
evaluation.within_mouse: Average MSE over two seeds within each condition. D_mouse(control)=1-mean_seed_MSE(functional)/mean_seed_MSE(control).
evaluation.across_mice: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of four D_mouse values, separately for random and global; never pool frames, neurons or seeds as independent mice.
evaluation.practical_replication_gate: Against BOTH controls: mean mouse benefit>=2%, all4 mouse benefits>0, >=6/8 paired mouse-seed wins. Also all8 functional fits must beat their own untrained versions and training-mean constant on evaluation.
evaluation.interpretation: Provisional practical consistency gate; passing is replication support for this recipe, not statistical significance or general utility.
evaluation.report: All24 bounded/unbounded normalized MSEs, bounded R2 (null for zero target variance), physical-unit RMSE, selected epochs, constant/own-untrained errors; all4 mouse effects and8 paired effects per contrast, equal-weight mean and leave-one-mouse-out means. Flag epoch0/24 and incomplete fits.
evaluation.statistics: Descriptive effects primary. Two-sided exact sign test across nonzero mouse effects: min(1,2*Binomial(n,0.5).CDF(min(positive,negative))), ties omitted. Report raw and Holm-adjusted p for both contrasts. At n=4 minimum two-sided p=0.125, one-sided p=0.0625. Do not use overlapping windows or technical seeds to claim animal-level significance.
evaluation.secondary: No extra fitted models, posthoc subgroup tests, correlation permutation sweeps or coordinate ablations in this batch. Training-group spatial plots may illustrate results.

checks: Before scoring record adapter source hash/package versions and verify protocol/reference hashes; verify paired IDs, labels, normalization, initialization, parameter counts and batch order.
Test new loader on synthetic arrays: triple means/tail removal, window alignment, split separation, training-only normalization. Do not rerun completed publisher/raw-data diagnostics.
During fitting check masks/group sizes and finite loss/gradients/parameters; reload every checkpoint on full selection interval.
After all checkpoints lock, score evaluation once; independently recompute saved metrics and aggregation. Archive24 histories/checkpoints, predictions, IDs/groups/statistics and hashes.
stop_rule: Exactly24 planned neural fits. No adaptive extra seeds/pools/epochs/thresholds/methods/mouse replacements. Technical retries retain planned task. Systematic bugs require documented amendment and rerunning affected matched conditions; disclose prior evaluation exposure.
limitations: Four mice, one session and one2048-cell pool each; two technical seeds.
Separate within-session fits test replication, not transfer to unseen mice/IDs.
Activity associations can reflect shared state/artifacts; no causal connectivity, realistic generation or coordinate-benefit claim.
Resampling documented by authors; exact per-session timestamps/internal acquisition boundaries not independently verified.
Fixed inherited training budget; failure does not rule out every functional model.
No ID/activity removal arms: grouping added to activity+ID is tested, not separate necessity of either input.
